en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a bustling scene in Piazza San Marco. People in early 20th‑century clothing stand and feed pigeons in the square. On the right is the ornate facade and domes of the Basilica di San Marco, while on the left are the surrounding historic buildings and the clock tower. Large flags hang prominently in the foreground. Printed text in Italian appears at the top describing the view.
